import numpy as np, mujoco, scipy.sparse as sp, osqp
from rcb_hb import Session

def terrain(x):
 h=0.
 for center in [3.2,9.2,15.2,21.2]:
  for k in range(5):
   if abs(x-center)<2.7-.6*k: h=max(h,.18*(k+1))
 return h

class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s,period=.65,length=.6,width=.36,lift=.18,ds=.20,height=.98):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data;self.period=period;self.ds=ds;self.lift=lift;self.height=height
  self.q0=self.d.qpos[7:].copy();self.q0[:10]=[0,0,-.35,.7,-.35]*2;self.q0[10:]=0
  self.N=1000;self.dt=.02;self.start=.5
  self.feet=[self.d.site_xpos[1].copy(),self.d.site_xpos[2].copy()];self.feet[0][2]=self.feet[1][2]=0
  self.plan=[]
  for n in range(50):
   side=n%2; x=.5+length*n+.20
   self.plan.append((side,np.array([x,width/2*(1 if side==0 else -1),terrain(x)+.003])))
  self.zmp=[];self.ref=[];self.phases=[]
  feet=[f.copy() for f in self.feet]
  for i in range(1800):
   t=i*self.dt
   if t<self.start:
    u=t/self.start; z=(1-u)*np.mean(feet,axis=0)+u*feet[1]; phase=(-1,u,feet.copy(),feet.copy())
   else:
    n=int((t-self.start)/period); u=((t-self.start)/period)-n
    old=[f.copy() for f in self.feet]
    for j in range(n):old[self.plan[j][0]]=self.plan[j][1].copy()
    new=[f.copy() for f in old];sw,target=self.plan[n];new[sw]=target.copy();stance=1-sw
    if u<1-ds:z=old[stance].copy()
    else:
     a=(u-(1-ds))/ds;z=(1-a)*old[stance]+a*target
    phase=(sw,u,old,new)
   self.zmp.append(z);self.phases.append(phase)
  self.zmp=np.array(self.zmp);om=np.sqrt(9.81/(height-.1));xi=self.zmp.copy()
  decay=np.exp(-om*self.dt)
  for i in range(len(xi)-2,-1,-1):xi[i,:2]=decay*xi[i+1,:2]+(1-decay)*self.zmp[i,:2]
  com=np.zeros_like(xi);com[0]=self.d.subtree_com[1];
  for i in range(len(com)-1):com[i+1,:2]=xi[i,:2]+(com[i,:2]-xi[i,:2])*decay
  # smooth terrain height with short symmetric filtering
  zs=self.zmp[:,2]; ker=np.ones(19)/19;zs=np.convolve(np.pad(zs,(9,9),mode='edge'),ker,mode='valid')
  com[:,2]=zs+(self.d.subtree_com[1,2]-self.feet[0][2])
  self.com=com;self.comv=np.gradient(com,self.dt,axis=0);self.coma=np.gradient(self.comv,self.dt,axis=0)
  self.jp=np.zeros((3,25));self.jr=np.zeros((3,25));self.prevJ=None;self.prevJc=None
  self.kp=s.model.actuator_gainprm[:,0];self.kd=-s.model.actuator_biasprm[:,2]
  self.ql=self.m.actuator_ctrlrange[:,0];self.qh=self.m.actuator_ctrlrange[:,1]
  self.solver=None
 def action(self,i):
  m,d=self.m,self.d;nv=25
  # kinematic task rows on qdd
  As=[];bs=[];weights=[]
  def task(J,goal,vel,acc,kp,kd,w):
   As.append(J.copy());bs.append(acc+kp*goal-kd*vel);weights.extend([w]*len(goal))
  Jc=np.zeros((3,nv));mujoco.mj_jacSubtreeCom(m,d,Jc,1)
  cv=Jc@d.qvel
  jc_dot=np.zeros(3) if self.prevJc is None else ((Jc-self.prevJc)/.02)@d.qvel
  task(Jc,self.com[i]-d.subtree_com[1],cv-self.comv[i],self.coma[i]-jc_dot,70,16,5)
  self.prevJc=Jc.copy()
  Jp=np.zeros((3,nv));Jr=np.zeros((3,nv));mujoco.mj_jacBody(m,d,Jp,Jr,12)
  R=d.xmat[12].reshape(3,3); rot=.5*np.array([R[2,1]-R[1,2],R[0,2]-R[2,0],R[1,0]-R[0,1]])
  task(Jr,-rot,Jr@d.qvel,np.zeros(3),120,20,8)
  task(np.eye(nv)[6:],self.q0-d.qpos[7:],d.qvel[6:],np.zeros(19),15,6,.1)
  sw,u,old,new=self.phases[i];support=[True,True]
  footJs=[];facc=[]
  for side,sid in enumerate([1,2]):
   mujoco.mj_jacSite(m,d,Jp,Jr,sid);J=np.vstack([Jp,Jr]);footJs.append(J.copy())
   fd=np.zeros(3);fa=np.zeros(3)
   if side==sw and u<1-self.ds:
    support[side]=False;p=u/(1-self.ds);a=old[side];b=new[side];T=self.period*(1-self.ds)
    # minimum jerk x/y; arch z with higher lift during ascent
    smooth=10*p**3-15*p**4+6*p**5;sv=(30*p**2-60*p**3+30*p**4)/T;sa=(60*p-180*p**2+120*p**3)/T**2
    fp=a+(b-a)*smooth;fd=(b-a)*sv;fa=(b-a)*sa
    arch=self.lift*16*p*p*(1-p)**2
    fp[2]+=arch;fd[2]+=self.lift*32*p*(1-p)*(1-2*p)/T;fa[2]+=self.lift*32*(1-6*p+6*p*p)/T**2
   else:fp=new[side] if side==sw else old[side]
   R=d.site_xmat[sid].reshape(3,3);rot=.5*np.array([R[2,1]-R[1,2],R[0,2]-R[2,0],R[1,0]-R[0,1]])
   err=np.r_[fp-d.site_xpos[sid],-rot];vd=np.r_[fd,np.zeros(3)];ad=np.r_[fa,np.zeros(3)]
   task(J,err,J@d.qvel-vd,ad,180,25,12 if support[side] else 4)
  A=np.vstack(As);b=np.hstack(bs);w=np.array(weights);A*=w[:,None];b*=w
  # variables qdd(25), two foot wrenches(12)
  M=np.zeros((nv,nv));mujoco.mj_fullM(m,M,d.qM)
  Jall=np.vstack(footJs); B=np.hstack([M,-Jall.T]);bias=d.qfrc_bias-d.qfrc_passive
  P=np.zeros((37,37));P[:25,:25]=A.T@A+np.eye(25)*.01;P[25:,25:]=np.diag([.0001,.0001,.00001,.003,.003,.003]*2)
  q=np.r_[-A.T@b,np.zeros(12)]
  cons=[B[:6]];lo=[-bias[:6]];hi=[-bias[:6]]
  # torque range on remaining dynamics rows
  cons.append(B[6:]);lo.append(m.actuator_forcerange[:,0]-bias[6:]);hi.append(m.actuator_forcerange[:,1]-bias[6:])
  for side in range(2):
   mat=np.zeros((11,37));offset=25+side*6
   mat[0,offset+2]=1
   for j,(axis,lim) in enumerate([(0,.7),(1,.7),(3,.045),(4,.12),(5,.025)]):
    mat[1+2*j,offset+axis]=1;mat[1+2*j,offset+2]=-lim
    mat[2+2*j,offset+axis]=-1;mat[2+2*j,offset+2]=-lim
   cons.append(mat);lo.append(np.r_[0,np.full(10,-np.inf)]);hi.append(np.r_[900 if support[side] else 0,np.zeros(10)])
  C=np.vstack(cons);l=np.hstack(lo);h=np.hstack(hi)
  # Fixed dense sparsity lets OSQP reuse matrix structure.
  ps=sp.csc_matrix(np.triu(P)+np.triu(np.ones_like(P)*1e-15));cs=sp.csc_matrix(C+1e-15)
  if self.solver is None:
   self.solver=osqp.OSQP();self.solver.setup(P=ps,q=q,A=cs,l=l,u=h,verbose=False,eps_abs=1e-3,eps_rel=1e-3,max_iter=200,polishing=False)
  else:self.solver.update(Px=ps.data,q=q,Ax=cs.data,l=l,u=h)
  res=self.solver.solve();x=res.x
  tau=B[6:]@x+bias[6:]
  target=d.qpos[7:]+(tau+self.kd*d.qvel[6:])/self.kp
  return np.clip(2*(target-self.ql)/(self.qh-self.ql)-1,-1,1)

def rollout(params={},save=False,verbose=False):
 s=Session('stair',instance='/app/instance.npz');c=Controller(s,**params);metrics=[]
 with s.recording() as rec:
  for i in range(1000):
   a=c.action(i);_,_,done=s.step(a)
   d=s.data;v=s.low.robot.center_of_mass_velocity();height=s.low.robot.head_height()-(s.low.robot.left_foot_height()+s.low.robot.right_foot_height())/2
   metrics.append([i,d.qpos[0],d.qpos[1],d.qpos[2],v[0],s.low.robot.torso_upright(),height,np.mean(d.actuator_force**2)])
   if verbose and i%50==0:print(np.round(metrics[-1],3),flush=True)
   if done:break
 if save:s.save_trajectory(rec.actions,'/app/output/trajectory.npz');np.save('/app/output/metrics.npy',metrics)
 return np.array(metrics),rec.actions,s
if __name__=='__main__':
 import sys,json
 p=json.loads(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else {}
 met,a,s=rollout(p,True,True);print('end',s.status())
